about: Background for each fan theory in our own words (2026-11-21). Every paragraph names a checkable source: a scene, a comic issue or an article.

maya-killed-kingpin.t: Maya Lopez came from the comics, where she first appeared in 1999. In that story Wilson Fisk had killed her father and then raised her as his own, and Maya later learned the truth. Hawkeye kept that shape: Maya's father dies in a raid by Ronin, and in the finale she learns from Kazi that Fisk set it up.
maya-killed-kingpin.src: Daredevil vol. 2 #9 (1999), by David Mack and Joe Quesada; Hawkeye, episodes 5 and 6

maya-killed-kingpin.t: Echo, released in January 2024, returned to the alley. Its first episode shows Maya pull the trigger with the gun close to Fisk's face. Fisk lives, and later in the show he follows her to her family's town in Oklahoma. In the finale she uses the power her ancestors pass to her to show him a memory from his own childhood, and he leaves.
Fisk's story kept going after that. In Daredevil: Born Again he runs for mayor of New York and wins, which only works because Maya did not kill him in that alley.

symbiote-piece-stays-in-mcu.t: The scrap ties two credits scenes together. Venom: Let There Be Carnage ends with Eddie and Venom pulled into the MCU, where they see Peter Parker's face on a TV news report. No Way Home's mid-credits scene picks up in a bar, where a bartender explains Thanos and the snap to Eddie before Strange's spell sends him home.
symbiote-piece-stays-in-mcu.src: Venom: Let There Be Carnage, mid-credits scene; Spider-Man: No Way Home, mid-credits scene

symbiote-piece-stays-in-mcu.t: Sony then closed Eddie's story in his own world. In Venom: The Last Dance the symbiote gives its life so Eddie can live, which leaves the drop on the bar as the only Venom piece still in the MCU.

moon-knight-all-in-his-head.t: Moon Knight first appeared in 1975 as a hired fighter in a werewolf story and got his own book later. The hospital idea is older than the show: Jeff Lemire and Greg Smallwood's 2016 series opens with Marc locked in a psychiatric ward, unsure whether Khonshu is a god or an illness. The show borrows that doubt almost scene for scene.
moon-knight-all-in-his-head.src: Werewolf by Night #32 (1975), by Doug Moench and Don Perlin; Moon Knight vol. 8 #1 (2016), by Jeff Lemire and Greg Smallwood

moon-knight-all-in-his-head.t: Episode 5 explains where Steven came from: as a boy, Marc's brother Randall drowned in a cave, his mother blamed him, and Steven grew out of that pain. The finale's credits scene then shows a third person in Marc's body, Jake Lockley, who kills Harrow for Khonshu. Fans on both sides use that scene: one more personality, or proof that Khonshu is real.
moon-knight-all-in-his-head.src: Moon Knight, episode 5 and episode 6 credits scene (Disney+, 2022)

arishem-returns-for-judgment.t: In the finale, Sersi turns the Celestial Tiamut to stone before it can hatch out of the Earth. Arishem then pulls Sersi, Kingo and Phastos into space and says he will read their memories to decide whether humans are worth saving. The other Eternals on Earth do not know where their friends went.

The Celestials were created by Jack Kirby in his own Eternals comic in 1976. In the 2022 event A.X.E.: Judgment Day, an Eternal builds a new Celestial that judges every person on Earth at once, which is the comic fans point to when they guess how the film's promise might pay off.
arishem-returns-for-judgment.src: The Eternals #2 (1976), by Jack Kirby; A.X.E.: Judgment Day (2022), by Kieron Gillen and Valerio Schiti

loki-took-tesseract-ragnarok.t: The cube had been in Asgard since The Avengers, when Thor took it home with Loki. Thor: The Dark World even mentions it: the Asgardians hand the Aether to the Collector because keeping two Infinity Stones in the same place felt unwise. That line told fans the Tesseract was still sitting in Odin's vault in Ragnarok.
loki-took-tesseract-ragnarok.src: The Avengers (2012), ending; Thor: The Dark World (2013), mid-credits scene

time-heist-created-doom.t: The heist in Endgame sends the team to four places: New York in 2012, Asgard in 2013, Morag and Vormir in 2014, and a New Jersey army base in 1970. The Ancient One warns Bruce that taking a stone splits off a new timeline, and Bruce promises the stones will go back. Steve returns them at the end, but the 2012 Loki escape with the Tesseract had already started a branch, which the Loki series follows.
time-heist-created-doom.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), the Sanctum rooftop and the ending; Loki, episode 1 (Disney+, 2021)

time-heist-created-doom.t: The mother-and-son tapestry has a comic reading too. In the comics Doom's mother, Cynthia von Doom, was a witch whose soul was taken by Mephisto, and Victor turned to sorcery to free her. When Doom finally wins in the 2015 Secret Wars, he rules a world stitched together from broken universes.
time-heist-created-doom.src: Fantastic Four #5 (1962), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Secret Wars (2015), by Jonathan Hickman and Esad Ribic

peter-felt-the-snap.t: Infinity War sets the sense up early. When the Black Order's ship arrives over New York, the hair on Peter's arm stands up on his school bus before anyone sees it. Aunt May calls it his Peter Tingle. On Titan he says he does not feel so good well before the dust reaches him, so the film had already shown he feels danger coming.
peter-felt-the-snap.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the school bus scene and the snap on Titan

peter-felt-the-snap.t: Spider-Man: Far From Home makes the sense part of the plot. Peter loses trust in it, and in the final fight with Mysterio he closes his eyes and uses it to dodge the drones through the illusions.
peter-felt-the-snap.src: Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), the bridge fight

doom-is-tony-variant.t: Downey was revealed as Doom at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2024, when he took off a mask on stage in Hall H, along with the news that the Russo brothers would direct. The film had been planned around Kang, until Marvel dropped Jonathan Majors in December 2023 and the next Avengers film took Doom's name instead.
doom-is-tony-variant.src: Marvel Studios panel, San Diego Comic-Con, July 27, 2024

doom-is-tony-variant.t: The comics have already put Doom in Tony's armor. In Infamous Iron Man, Victor von Doom takes the Iron Man name while Tony is out of action and tries to be a hero. Fans use that run as proof that the two men can swap places without being the same person.
doom-is-tony-variant.src: Infamous Iron Man #1 (2016), by Brian Michael Bendis and Alex Maleev

wanda-survived-wundagore.t: Wundagore is an old comic location, a mountain in Eastern Europe that first showed up as the base of the High Evolutionary. In the film it is the place where the Darkhold was first written and where Wanda's throne of the Scarlet Witch sits. She uses her power to bring the mountain down and destroy every copy of the Darkhold across the multiverse.
wanda-survived-wundagore.src: Thor #134 (1966), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022), climax

wanda-survived-wundagore.t: The search for her has kept going since. WandaVision ended with Wanda reading the Darkhold in a cabin and hearing her sons call for help, and Agatha All Along ends with Billy setting out to find his brother Tommy. Both stories leave a reason for Wanda to come back.
wanda-survived-wundagore.src: WandaVision, episode 9 post-credits scene (2021); Agatha All Along, finale (2024)

hulk-was-snapped.t: Infinity War opens with Thanos beating the Hulk on the Asgardian ship. Heimdall sends him back to Earth with the last of his power, and from then on the Hulk will not come out: not in the Sanctum and not in Wakanda, where Bruce fights in Tony's Hulkbuster armor instead. That refusal is why fans thought something had broken.
hulk-was-snapped.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the opening and the battle of Wakanda

hulk-was-snapped.t: Endgame gives the answer in the diner scene. Bruce says he spent 18 months in a gamma lab bringing the brains and the brawn together, and he appears as a green Hulk with Bruce's mind and glasses. He later wears the gauntlet to bring everyone back, and his arm is badly burned.
hulk-was-snapped.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), the diner scene and the snap

tony-anchor-being.t: In Deadpool & Wolverine, Mr. Paradox of the TVA tells Wade that his world's anchor was Logan, who died in Logan (2017). With the anchor gone, that world will slowly end, and Paradox plans to speed it up with a machine. Wade's fix is to bring in a Logan from another world. The idea that one hero holds a world together comes straight from that film.

Fans link it to Endgame because Tony is the one who chooses to die. Strange tells him on Titan that there was one future out of 14,000,605 where they win, and in the final battle he holds up one finger to Tony before Tony snaps. If Tony was this world's anchor, the theory goes, that win came at a cost no one counted.
tony-anchor-being.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), Titan; Avengers: Endgame (2019), the final battle

tony-anchor-being.t: Incursions, the word Clea uses, come from Jonathan Hickman's New Avengers comics, where whole Earths crash into each other. That run led into the 2015 Secret Wars.
tony-anchor-being.src: New Avengers vol. 3 #1 (2013), by Jonathan Hickman and Steve Epting

loki-holds-the-multiverse.t: Season 2 builds to the moment. The Temporal Loom, the machine that turns raw time into timelines, cannot handle all the new branches and starts to break. Ouroboros, the TVA's repairman, and Victor Timely try to fix it, and when it fails Loki walks out into the storm and pulls the dying timelines together with his own hands.

The tree image comes from Norse myth, where the world tree Yggdrasil links the nine realms. The original Secret Wars of 1984 starts when the Beyonder, a being from outside the universe, pulls heroes and villains to a world he made to fight. Fans who see Loki as the new Beyonder lean on that comic.
loki-holds-the-multiverse.src: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #1 (1984), by Jim Shooter and Mike Zeck

adamantium-from-tiamut.t: In the comics adamantium has a very different start. It first appeared in 1969 as a metal made in a lab, an alloy a scientist named Myron MacLain stumbled on while trying to copy Captain America's shield. The MCU already had a metal from space in vibranium, which reached Wakanda on a meteor, so a space source for adamantium fits the films' own pattern.
adamantium-from-tiamut.src: The Avengers #66 (1969), by Roy Thomas and Barry Windsor-Smith; Black Panther (2018), opening

uncle-ben-suitcase.t: Ben Parker died in Peter's first comic, Amazing Fantasy #15 in 1962, and the line about great power and great responsibility closes that story. Tobey Maguire's and Andrew Garfield's films both showed his death on screen, so Tom Holland's films were the first to leave it out.
uncle-ben-suitcase.src: Amazing Fantasy #15 (1962), by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko

uncle-ben-suitcase.t: No Way Home gives Holland's Peter that lesson another way. Aunt May says the great power line to him as she dies, and the other two Peters tell him about losing their Uncle Bens. In this world May fills the role Ben had in the others.
uncle-ben-suitcase.src: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), May's death and the rooftop scene

mysterio-multiverse-real.t: Mysterio first appeared in 1964 as a Hollywood special effects man who turns his tricks into crimes, so fans of the comics expected a con from the start. The film ties Beck to Tony: he built the B.A.R.F. memory tech that Tony shows off at MIT in Captain America: Civil War, and Beck says Tony fired him and renamed his work.
mysterio-multiverse-real.src: The Amazing Spider-Man #13 (1964), by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko; Captain America: Civil War (2016), the MIT speech

mysterio-multiverse-real.t: The credits scenes show how much of the film was a lie. Beck's doctored video names Peter as Spider-Man on TheDailyBugle.net, and the last scene reveals that the Nick Fury and Maria Hill in the film were the Skrulls Talos and Soren.
mysterio-multiverse-real.src: Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), mid-credits and post-credits scenes

loki-mind-controlled.t: The Avengers shows Loki come through the Tesseract portal with the scepter already in his hand. Thanos's servant, the Other, threatens him when he is slow to deliver, and the credits scene shows Thanos himself smiling. Loki is an envoy working for someone more powerful, not a free agent.
loki-mind-controlled.src: The Avengers (2012), the opening and the Other's scenes

loki-mind-controlled.t: Avengers: Age of Ultron later reveals what the gem on the scepter is: the Mind Stone, which Ultron uses to build a body that becomes Vision. Once fans knew the scepter held a stone that bends minds, Loki's long hours holding it in 2012 looked different.
loki-mind-controlled.src: Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), the cradle scene and Vision's birth

loki-mind-controlled.t: Endgame adds a small echo. During the 2012 heist, the scepter is in Hydra's hands in the elevator, and Steve gets it by saying the words Hail Hydra.
loki-mind-controlled.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), the Stark Tower elevator

loki-escapes-with-tesseract.t: The Loki series picks up the second after Endgame's heist. The 2012 Loki lands in the Gobi Desert and is arrested at once by the Time Variance Authority for leaving his set timeline. In the first episode Mobius shows him films of his own future, including his death at Thanos's hands, which this Loki has not lived yet.

From there the variant grows apart from the Loki of the films. He meets Sylvie, another Loki variant, finds He Who Remains at the end of time in the season 1 finale, and in season 2 takes his place holding the timelines together. The escape in Endgame turned into the start of his longest story.
loki-escapes-with-tesseract.src: Loki, season 1 episode 6 (2021) and season 2 episode 6 (2023)

laura-barton-agent-19.t: Laura first appeared in Avengers: Age of Ultron, when Clint takes the team to his hidden farm and they learn he has a wife and children. Nothing in that film said she had been an agent. In the comics Clint's wife was Bobbi Morse, the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent known as Mockingbird, and the two were married in the 1983 Hawkeye miniseries.
laura-barton-agent-19.src: Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), the Barton farm; Hawkeye #4 (1983), by Mark Gruenwald

laura-barton-agent-19.t: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. used Bobbi Morse as a separate person, played by Adrianne Palicki, which is why the number 19 caused so much debate.

hela-is-alive.t: Hela comes from Norse myth, where she rules the realm of the dead. In the comics she first appeared in 1964. Thor: Ragnarok made her Odin's first child, locked away when her hunger for war scared him. Her prison breaks only because Odin dies, which is why she arrives the moment he fades away on the cliff in Norway.
hela-is-alive.src: Journey into Mystery #102 (1964), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Thor: Ragnarok (2017), Odin's death

endgame-rat-is-ant-man-rat.t: Scott's first shrink in Ant-Man starts in a bathtub. He is washed off his feet, tumbles through the building and, before he can grow back, comes face to face with a rat. The rat theory lives on that single scene.
endgame-rat-is-ant-man-rat.src: Ant-Man (2015), Scott's first test of the suit

endgame-rat-is-ant-man-rat.t: The second half comes from Ant-Man and the Wasp's mid-credits scene. Scott goes into the Quantum Realm from Luis's van, and Hank, Janet and Hope turn to dust in the snap while he waits for them to pull him out. Five years pass outside before the rat steps on the button, though Scott says only five hours passed for him.
endgame-rat-is-ant-man-rat.src: Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018), mid-credits scene; Avengers: Endgame (2019), the storage unit

bucky-killed-tonys-parents.t: Zemo builds the whole film toward that tape. He bombs the signing of the Sokovia Accords in Vienna, frames Bucky for it, and lures Steve, Bucky and Tony to the Hydra base in Siberia only to play the footage for them. He wants the Avengers to tear each other apart.
bucky-killed-tonys-parents.src: Captain America: Civil War (2016), Vienna and the Siberian base

banner-and-hulk-merge.t: Professor Hulk comes from Peter David's run on the comic. In a 1991 issue, the psychiatrist Doc Samson merges Bruce's mind with the grey and green Hulks, and the result is a giant with Bruce's brain. Endgame's version even keeps Bruce's glasses and cardigan.
banner-and-hulk-merge.src: The Incredible Hulk #377 (1991), by Peter David and Dale Keown

banner-and-hulk-merge.t: She-Hulk later shows what happened to the arm Bruce burned with the gauntlet: it still carries scars, and Bruce teaches Jen to control her own form at his lab in Mexico.

tommy-in-a-new-body.t: The twins first came to the screen in WandaVision, where Wanda creates them inside her Westview fantasy. Tommy develops super speed and Billy can sense people's thoughts. When the Hex falls in the finale, both boys fade away with it, which is why Billy's return in Agatha All Along raised the question of where Tommy's soul went.
In the comics both boys were reborn too. Billy came back as Wiccan in the Young Avengers, and Tommy was found later as Speed, living in a juvenile detention center with no idea who his mother was.
tommy-in-a-new-body.src: Young Avengers #1 (2005) and #10 (2006), by Allan Heinberg and Jim Cheung

secret-wars-soft-reboot.t: The 2015 comic starts with the last incursion, when the main Marvel Earth and the Ultimate Earth crash into each other. Doom takes the power of the Beyonders and builds Battleworld from what is left, ruling it as God Emperor. At the end, Reed Richards takes that power and, with Franklin and Valeria, starts rebuilding the multiverse.
secret-wars-soft-reboot.src: Secret Wars #1 and #9 (2015 and 2016), by Jonathan Hickman and Esad Ribic

secret-wars-soft-reboot.t: Marvel first announced its two closing Avengers films at San Diego Comic-Con in 2022, then as The Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars. After Kang was dropped, the first film became Doomsday, and the Russo brothers took on both.
secret-wars-soft-reboot.src: Marvel Studios panel, San Diego Comic-Con, July 2022 and July 2024

peter-mutation-man-spider.t: Organic webs are not new to Spider-Man on film. Sam Raimi's 2002 Spider-Man gave Tobey Maguire's Peter webs that grow out of his wrists. In the comics, the 2005 storyline The Other has Peter die and come back with organic webs, night vision and stingers in his arms, which is the story Reddit users point to most.
peter-mutation-man-spider.src: Spider-Man (2002); Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man, Marvel Knights Spider-Man and The Amazing Spider-Man, The Other (2005 to 2006), by Peter David, Reginald Hudlin and J. Michael Straczynski

peter-mutation-man-spider.t: Man-Spider comes from television. In the 1990s animated series, the Neogenic Nightmare story has Peter's spider DNA keep changing until he turns into a six-armed monster, and a cure has to be found to change him back.
peter-mutation-man-spider.src: Spider-Man: The Animated Series, season 2, The Neogenic Nightmare (1995)

mephisto-in-wandavision.t: The comic link fans had in mind is real. In a 1989 Avengers story by John Byrne, Wanda learns that her twin sons were made from pieces of Mephisto's soul, and he takes them back into himself. Mephisto himself first appeared in a 1968 Silver Surfer comic. With twins on screen and a show about Wanda's grief, his name came up within days.
mephisto-in-wandavision.src: Silver Surfer #3 (1968), by Stan Lee and John Buscema; West Coast Avengers #51 and #52 (1989), by John Byrne

mephisto-in-wandavision.t: The fake commercials did hide real clues, just not about Mephisto. They advertised a Stark Industries toaster, a Strucker watch, Lagos paper towels and a Hydra Soak bath, each tied to a painful moment in Wanda's past. Episode 7 then names the real neighbor behind it all with a theme song: Agnes was Agatha Harkness the whole time.

adult-toussaint-other-timeline.t: Wakanda Forever was made after Chadwick Boseman's death in August 2020, and it opens with T'Challa's funeral. The mid-credits scene shows Nakia raising their son in Haiti, away from the pressure of the throne, and he tells Shuri his Wakandan name is T'Challa.
adult-toussaint-other-timeline.src: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022), opening and mid-credits scene

adult-toussaint-other-timeline.t: The comic Inverse mentions is a 2018 series by Ta-Nehisi Coates where T'Challa wakes up far in the future, in a Wakandan empire spread across another galaxy.
adult-toussaint-other-timeline.src: Black Panther vol. 7 #1 (2018), The Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda, by Ta-Nehisi Coates and Daniel Acuna

tony-ai-backup.t: The comic version fans mean is from 2016. After Tony is left in a coma, a digital copy of his mind wakes up inside Riri Williams's armor and acts as her guide, cracking jokes in her ear while she learns to be a hero. It is the clearest case of an AI Tony in print.
tony-ai-backup.src: Invincible Iron Man vol. 3 #1 (2017), by Brian Michael Bendis and Stefano Caselli

tony-ai-backup.t: The films gave Tony several AI helpers but never an AI Tony. J.A.R.V.I.S. ran his suits until he became part of Vision, F.R.I.D.A.Y. took over after that, and in Far From Home Peter inherits E.D.I.T.H., whose name stands for Even Dead I'm The Hero. Endgame also shows Tony record a goodbye for Pepper inside his helmet while stranded in space, which is why fans think he knew how to leave messages behind.
tony-ai-backup.src: Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015); Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019); Avengers: Endgame (2019), the opening on the Benatar

tony-ai-backup.t: When Ironheart reached Disney+, Riri's helper was her own AI, N.A.T.A.L.I.E., built from the memory of her late best friend Natalie, not Tony.

steve-met-red-skull-returning-stone.t: The Skull was last seen in Captain America: The First Avenger, when he grabs the Tesseract aboard his plane and disappears in a beam of light. Infinity War answered where he went: the Space Stone sent him to Vormir, where he guides people to the Soul Stone and cannot leave. A different actor, Ross Marquand, plays him there.
steve-met-red-skull-returning-stone.src: Captain America: The First Avenger (2011), the Valkyrie; Avengers: Infinity War (2018), Vormir

steve-met-red-skull-returning-stone.t: That makes the return a meeting of two old enemies, both out of their time. Steve then goes on to live his life with Peggy and comes back as an old man to hand the shield to Sam, so whatever happened on Vormir, he finished the trip.

soul-stone-in-wakanda-or-heimdall.t: By 2017 the films had shown five stones. The Tesseract held the Space Stone, Loki's scepter the Mind Stone, the Aether the Reality Stone, the Orb in Guardians of the Galaxy the Power Stone, and the Eye of Agamotto in Doctor Strange the Time Stone. The Collector names all six in Guardians, but the Soul Stone never appeared, which is why the hunt for it got so wild.
soul-stone-in-wakanda-or-heimdall.src: Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), the Collector's scene; Doctor Strange (2016)

soul-stone-in-wakanda-or-heimdall.t: Infinity War hid the answer with Gamora. She had found the map to the Soul Stone and kept it from Thanos, and her sister Nebula gives the secret away under torture. Thanos takes Gamora to Vormir, where Red Skull tells him the stone demands the life of someone he loves, and he throws her off the cliff.
soul-stone-in-wakanda-or-heimdall.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), Thanos's ship and Vormir

natasha-returns-from-soul-stone.t: On Vormir, Clint and Natasha fight each other for the right to die. She wins and falls, and Clint wakes holding the stone. Her story still went on after Endgame. Black Widow, set years earlier, ends with her sister Yelena at her grave, told by Valentina that Clint was to blame.
natasha-returns-from-soul-stone.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), Vormir; Black Widow (2021), post-credits scene

natasha-returns-from-soul-stone.t: Hawkeye picks up that thread. Yelena tracks Clint down to kill him, and in the finale he tells her how Natasha chose to give her life. Yelena walks away, and nothing in that talk hints that Natasha can come back.

loki-disguised-as-banner.t: Loki has a record that made fans doubt this death. He lets go of the Bifrost and falls into space at the end of Thor. In Thor: The Dark World he seems to die in Thor's arms on Svartalfheim, then turns up on Asgard's throne disguised as Odin, a trick Thor only learns about in Ragnarok.
loki-disguised-as-banner.src: Thor (2011), ending; Thor: The Dark World (2013), ending; Thor: Ragnarok (2017), Asgard

loki-disguised-as-banner.t: Infinity War seems to answer the doubt on purpose. Loki tries to stab Thanos with a hidden dagger, Thanos chokes him and, after he dies, says there will be no resurrections this time.

hulk-afraid-of-thanos.t: The struggle the Russos point to starts on Sakaar. In Ragnarok the Hulk had stayed Hulk for two years as the Grandmaster's champion. When Bruce finally comes back, he fears that one more change could leave him trapped inside for good, and the Hulk, who now speaks in sentences, does not want to give his body back.

Infinity War picks up right after that. The Hulk loses to Thanos, and Heimdall sends him to Earth, where he crashes through the roof of Doctor Strange's Sanctum as Bruce and warns that Thanos is coming. After that the Hulk refuses every call, even when Bruce yells at him in the middle of a battle.
hulk-afraid-of-thanos.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the Sanctum and the battle of Wakanda

hood-power-from-mephisto.t: The Hood began in a 2002 comic by Brian K. Vaughan, where a small-time thief steals a magic cloak and boots from a demon he kills. Ironheart cast Anthony Ramos as Parker Robbins and changed him into a crew leader who robs from the rich, with the hood as the source of his power.
hood-power-from-mephisto.src: The Hood #1 (2002), by Brian K. Vaughan, Kyle Hotz and Eric Powell; Ironheart (Disney+, 2025)

everett-ross-skrull-how-long.t: Ross first appeared in the 1998 Black Panther comics as a government handler, and on film Martin Freeman played him across four films. In Civil War he runs the task force holding Bucky. In Black Panther he takes a bullet for Nakia in South Korea and Shuri heals him in Wakanda. In Wakanda Forever he is arrested for passing secrets to Wakanda, and Shuri's people break him out.
everett-ross-skrull-how-long.src: Black Panther vol. 3 #1 (1998), by Christopher Priest and Mark Texeira; Captain America: Civil War (2016); Black Panther (2018); Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022)

everett-ross-skrull-how-long.t: Secret Invasion says Skrulls had lived on Earth since the 1990s, when Nick Fury promised them a home after the events of Captain Marvel. That long timeline is what lets fans argue the swap could have come many years earlier.

cap-worthy-since-ultron.t: The rule comes from Thor's first comic: whoever holds the hammer, if he be worthy, shall possess the power of Thor. Age of Ultron also showed the hammer choosing someone else: Vision picks it up without effort and hands it to Thor. In the comics, Steve first lifted Mjolnir in a 1988 Thor issue, so readers expected it would happen on screen one day.
cap-worthy-since-ultron.src: Journey into Mystery #83 (1962), by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Jack Kirby; Thor #390 (1988), by Tom DeFalco and Ron Frenz; Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015)

ultron-lives-inside-vision.t: In the comics Ultron was built by Hank Pym, and in 1968 the robot built Vision to attack the Avengers. Age of Ultron moved Ultron's creation to Tony and Bruce, but kept the old family tie: Ultron starts the body that becomes Vision.
ultron-lives-inside-vision.src: The Avengers #54, #55 and #57 (1968), by Roy Thomas and John Buscema; Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015)

professor-x-hid-the-mutants.t: The MCU has shown other Xaviers. In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Patrick Stewart plays the Xavier of Earth-838, a member of that world's Illuminati, and Wanda kills him. The Marvels' mid-credits scene sends Monica Rambeau to a world with Kelsey Grammer's Beast, and Deadpool & Wolverine brings in the old Fox films' heroes through the TVA.
professor-x-hid-the-mutants.src: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022); The Marvels (2023), mid-credits scene; Deadpool & Wolverine (2024)

professor-x-hid-the-mutants.t: The X-Men themselves began in 1963 as students at Xavier's school, hidden from a public that feared them. The comics already have a story where mutants nearly vanish: in House of M, Wanda says no more mutants and most of them lose their powers in an instant.
professor-x-hid-the-mutants.src: X-Men #1 (1963), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; House of M #7 and #8 (2005), by Brian Michael Bendis and Olivier Coipel

fury-skrull-since-winter-soldier.t: The 2014 date comes from The Winter Soldier, where Fury is shot through a wall by the Winter Soldier and fakes his death with a drug that slows his heart. After that he spends most films off to the side. Far From Home's last scene shows the real Fury relaxing on a beach that turns out to be a fake setting on a Skrull ship in space, while Talos covers for him on Earth.
fury-skrull-since-winter-soldier.src: Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014); Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), post-credits scene

fury-skrull-since-winter-soldier.t: Secret Invasion fills in some of the gap. Fury has been working from S.A.B.E.R., a space station, since returning from the Blip, and he comes back to Earth to deal with Skrulls hiding in high places.

bangle-and-ten-rings-linked.t: Kamala Khan first got her own comic in 2014, written by G. Willow Wilson, and there her powers came from the Terrigen Mist that wakes up the Inhumans. The show swapped that for a family heirloom and the Noor dimension, and in episode 5 Kamala travels back to the Partition of India in 1947 and guides her own great-grandmother's family to safety.
bangle-and-ten-rings-linked.src: Ms. Marvel #1 (2014), by G. Willow Wilson and Adrian Alphona; Ms. Marvel, episode 5 (Disney+, 2022)

bangle-and-ten-rings-linked.t: The rings have their own unsolved mystery. Shang-Chi's mid-credits scene has Wong, Bruce Banner and Carol Danvers study them, and they find the rings are sending out a signal to somewhere no one knows.
bangle-and-ten-rings-linked.src: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021), mid-credits scene

ant-man-inside-thanos.t: The films had already shown both halves of the plan. Scott first grew to giant size at the airport fight in Captain America: Civil War, surprising both teams. And the Pym tech can shrink anything, from a tank on a key ring in Ant-Man to Hank's whole lab building pulled along like a suitcase in Ant-Man and the Wasp.
ant-man-inside-thanos.src: Captain America: Civil War (2016), the Leipzig airport; Ant-Man (2015); Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018)

ant-man-inside-thanos.t: In the end, Scott's big moment in Endgame is the time machine itself, plus a giant-size rescue at the end, when he lifts the rubble off the team during the final battle.
ant-man-inside-thanos.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), the compound and the final battle

time-keepers-are-fake.t: The TVA's whole story was told to Loki through Miss Minutes, its cheerful cartoon clock, in an orientation video. Only Judge Ravonna Renslayer had the right to meet the Time-Keepers in person, which is why fans figured she knew the truth. In the comics, too, the Time-Keepers were made by He Who Remains at the end of time.

spider-signal-in-space.t: The MCU already has Spider-Men from other worlds. No Way Home's spell pulled in Tobey Maguire's and Andrew Garfield's Peters, who fought beside Tom Holland's at the Statue of Liberty before Strange sent them home. In Sony's animated Across the Spider-Verse, Miguel O'Hara even brings up that event, blaming a Doctor Strange and a Peter Parker for tearing open the multiverse.
spider-signal-in-space.src: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), the final battle; Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023), Miguel's speech

spider-signal-in-space.t: Miles Morales, the name fans guess most, first appeared in 2011 as the Spider-Man of Marvel's Ultimate line. Space has a famous Spider-Man link too: in the 1984 Secret Wars, Peter finds his black suit on Battleworld, a planet far from Earth, and it turns out to be the alien symbiote that later becomes Venom.
spider-signal-in-space.src: Ultimate Fallout #4 (2011), by Brian Michael Bendis and Sara Pichelli; Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #8 (1984), by Jim Shooter and Mike Zeck

snapped-trapped-in-soul-stone.t: The comic fans leaned on is Jim Starlin's The Infinity Gauntlet from 1991. Thanos wipes out half of all life, and the heroes who are left fight him in space. The Soul Gem holds a world of its own, Soul World, where Adam Warlock lived in earlier Starlin comics. In the end Nebula takes the gauntlet and undoes the snap, so readers expected a rescue from inside a stone.
snapped-trapped-in-soul-stone.src: The Infinity Gauntlet #1 to #6 (1991), by Jim Starlin, George Perez and Ron Lim

snapped-trapped-in-soul-stone.t: Endgame chose time instead. Five years pass, the team takes the stones from the past, and when the Hulk snaps, the dusted come back where they were with no time gone for them. Peter wakes on Titan, and Strange arrives through portals with the armies of Wakanda and Asgard.
snapped-trapped-in-soul-stone.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), the second snap and the final battle

sentry-is-the-key-to-doomsday.t: The Sentry first appeared in 2000 as a hero with the power of a million exploding suns, whom the world has forgotten. His dark side is the Void, a second self that grows as strong as he is. In the 2010 comic Siege he tears Ares in half, which is why fans see him as Marvel's most dangerous hero.
sentry-is-the-key-to-doomsday.src: The Sentry #1 (2000), by Paul Jenkins and Jae Lee; Siege #2 (2010), by Brian Michael Bendis and Olivier Coipel

sentry-is-the-key-to-doomsday.t: Thunderbolts* told that story on screen. Bob Reynolds, played by Lewis Pullman, survives a lab experiment and becomes the Sentry, then the Void swallows New York in darkness. Yelena and the team pull him out by walking into his worst memories with him. The film ends with Valentina calling the group the New Avengers.

kingpin-is-uncle.t: The Kingpin was a Spider-Man villain first, created in 1967, before Frank Miller made him Daredevil's great enemy. Vincent D'Onofrio played him for three seasons of Netflix's Daredevil, so the photo in episode 5 was also the first sign that the Netflix Fisk was now part of the MCU.
kingpin-is-uncle.src: The Amazing Spider-Man #50 (1967), by Stan Lee and John Romita Sr.; Daredevil (Netflix, 2015 to 2018)

jack-duquesne-is-the-villain.t: Comic fans had a reason to watch Jack. The Swordsman first appeared in 1965, and in the comics he worked in the circus that raised Clint and trained him before turning to crime. Tony Dalton played Jack as a cheerful rich man with a sword collection, which made fans more suspicious, not less.
jack-duquesne-is-the-villain.src: The Avengers #19 (1965), by Stan Lee and Don Heck; Hawkeye (Disney+, 2021)

jack-duquesne-is-the-villain.t: The finale clears him. Kate learns that her mother Eleanor had Kazi kill Armand Duquesne, and that she had been working with Fisk. Eleanor is arrested, and Jack joins the fight at the Rockefeller Center party on Kate's side.

tony-left-arm.t: The left arm pain had a medical reading too. Pain in the left arm is a classic heart attack sign, and Tony's heart had been damaged since the shrapnel of the first Iron Man. Some fans saw the arm as a hint about his heart rather than a time echo.
tony-left-arm.src: Iron Man (2008), the cave in Afghanistan

tony-left-arm.t: The film's own detail goes against the theory: Tony wears the Stark-made gauntlet on his right hand, and it is the right side of his body that burns. Thanos had worn his gauntlet on the left, and his left arm is the one scarred after his snap in Infinity War. The damage follows the hand that snaps, not Tony's old injuries.
tony-left-arm.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), Wakanda; Avengers: Endgame (2019), Tony's snap

thor-dies-in-doomsday.t: Hemsworth has played Thor since 2011, through four solo films and every Avengers film. Thor: Love and Thunder ended with Jane Foster dying and Thor taking in Love, the daughter of Gorr, as his own. That daughter is who he prays to get home to.
thor-dies-in-doomsday.src: Thor (2011); Thor: Love and Thunder (2022), ending

thor-dies-in-doomsday.t: Love and Thunder's credits also left open threads: Zeus sends his son Hercules after Thor, and Jane is welcomed into Valhalla by Heimdall. Fans who think Thor dies point out that Valhalla has now been shown on screen, so the films already have a place to send him.
thor-dies-in-doomsday.src: Thor: Love and Thunder (2022), mid-credits and post-credits scenes

strange-is-mysterio.t: What If...? did not invent this Strange from nothing. Its fourth episode follows a Strange who lost Christine instead of his hands, breaks reality trying to bring her back and becomes Strange Supreme.

Beck's only part in No Way Home is the fallout from his lie. The film opens right after his doctored video names Peter as Spider-Man and blames him for Beck's death, and the angry crowds and the legal case that follow are why Peter goes to Strange for a spell in the first place.
strange-is-mysterio.src: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), opening; Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), mid-credits scene

steve-was-peggys-husband.t: Peggy's other men are on record too. In Civil War, Sharon Carter, revealed as Peggy's great-niece, gives the eulogy at her funeral in London. The Agent Carter TV series showed Peggy falling for Daniel Sousa in the 1940s, which fans count against the theory.
steve-was-peggys-husband.src: Captain America: Civil War (2016), the funeral; Agent Carter, season 2 (ABC, 2016)

star-lord-still-celestial.t: In the comics Peter Quill first appeared in 1976, with a very different father: J'son, the emperor of the Spartax. Vol. 2 swapped in Ego, a planet with a mind, played by Kurt Russell in a human body.
star-lord-still-celestial.src: Marvel Preview #4 (1976), by Steve Englehart and Steve Gan; Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017)

stan-lee-watcher.t: Lee died in November 2018, and his last filmed cameo is in Endgame: a driver in 1970 New Jersey who shouts 'Make love, not war!' as he passes Camp Lehigh. Fans who back the Watcher reading count that as one more stop on his trip through time.
stan-lee-watcher.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), the 1970 Camp Lehigh scene

riri-sold-her-soul.t: Riri Williams first appeared in a 2016 Iron Man comic as a teen genius who builds her own armor in a dorm room. In the show, Dominique Thorne's Riri carries the loss of her friend Natalie and her stepfather through every episode, which is the grief Mephisto offers to fix.
riri-sold-her-soul.src: Invincible Iron Man vol. 3 #7 (2016), by Brian Michael Bendis and Mike Deodato; Ironheart (Disney+, 2025)

riri-sold-her-soul.t: Mephisto's deals in the comics always come due. The best known is One More Day, where Peter and Mary Jane give up their marriage to save Aunt May's life. Fans expect any Riri bargain to work the same way: a gift now, a heavy price later.
riri-sold-her-soul.src: The Amazing Spider-Man #545 (2007), One More Day, by J. Michael Straczynski and Joe Quesada

ned-handshake-breaks-spell.t: No Way Home had already shown that Ned has a gift. He opens portals with Wong's sling ring by accident, bringing in Tobey Maguire's and Andrew Garfield's Peters, and his grandmother says he has a talent. At the end, Strange's spell makes the world forget Peter Parker, and Peter visits Ned and MJ at a coffee shop but does not tell them who he is.
ned-handshake-breaks-spell.src: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), Ned's house and the ending

ned-handshake-breaks-spell.t: The comic Ned Leeds was a reporter and Peter's friend from the 1960s. The MCU's Ned, played by Jacob Batalon, owes more to Ganke Lee, the best friend of Miles Morales, who keeps the secret and helps from the computer.
ned-handshake-breaks-spell.src: The Amazing Spider-Man #18 (1964), by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko; Ultimate Comics Spider-Man (2011), by Brian Michael Bendis and Sara Pichelli

groot-last-words-dad.t: Groot first appeared in 1960 as a tree monster from another planet who wants to take a town back to his world. The heroic Groot came later. On film, Vin Diesel recorded the same three words in many languages so they would be his own voice around the world.
groot-last-words-dad.src: Tales to Astonish #13 (1960), by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Jack Kirby; Guardians of the Galaxy (2014)

foggy-is-alive.t: Foggy has been Matt's partner since the first Daredevil comic in 1964, and Elden Henson played him for three seasons of Netflix's Daredevil, so his death in the first minutes of Born Again was a shock on purpose. Matt chases Bullseye onto the roof and throws him off, then the show jumps a year ahead, with Matt alone and Karen gone from New York.
foggy-is-alive.src: Daredevil #1 (1964), by Stan Lee and Bill Everett; Daredevil: Born Again, episode 1 (Disney+, 2025)

foggy-is-alive.t: The rest of the season keeps his loss in view. Matt opens a new practice without him, and Bullseye's trial and later prison scenes keep the shooting on screen.

fietro-x-men-quicksilver.t: There were two Quicksilvers on film before WandaVision. Aaron Taylor-Johnson played the MCU's Pietro in Age of Ultron, where he dies in Sokovia shielding Clint and a child from gunfire. Evan Peters played Fox's version, best known for the slow-motion kitchen rescue in X-Men: Days of Future Past. In the comics, the twins began as members of Magneto's Brotherhood of Evil Mutants in 1964.
fietro-x-men-quicksilver.src: Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015); X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014); The X-Men #4 (1964), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby

fietro-x-men-quicksilver.t: The show played with the swap. When Peters arrives at Wanda's door in episode 5, Darcy, watching from outside, says they recast Pietro. The finale's joke is in the name: Agnes had kept mentioning a husband called Ralph, and the man in Pietro's body turns out to be Ralph Bohner.

doctor-strange-in-wandavision.t: The show did lead straight into Strange's film another way. Its post-credits scene shows Wanda alone in a mountain cabin, reading the Darkhold while she hears her sons crying for help. Multiverse of Madness opens with her already using that book's power.
doctor-strange-in-wandavision.src: WandaVision, episode 9 post-credits scene (2021); Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)

collector-survived.t: Taneleer Tivan, the Collector, first appeared in a 1966 Avengers comic as an old alien who hoards rare things. On film, Benicio del Toro showed him in Guardians of the Galaxy, where he keeps his museum on Knowhere, a mining colony built inside the severed head of a dead Celestial. Guardians Vol. 3 later shows the team living there and rebuilding it.
collector-survived.src: The Avengers #28 (1966), by Stan Lee and Don Heck; Guardians of the Galaxy (2014); Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023)

avengers-vs-x-men-doomsday.t: The fight has a comic of the same name. In the 2012 event Avengers vs. X-Men, the cosmic Phoenix Force heads for Earth and the two teams split over what to do about Hope Summers, the girl it seems to want. Cyclops ends up holding the Phoenix and kills Charles Xavier, one of the darkest turns in X-Men history.
avengers-vs-x-men-doomsday.src: Avengers vs. X-Men #0 to #12 (2012), by Brian Michael Bendis, Jason Aaron, Ed Brubaker, Jonathan Hickman and Matt Fraction

avengers-vs-x-men-doomsday.t: The cast list goes back to Fox's first X-Men film in 2000, which starred Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen. Disney bought Fox's film business in 2019, which brought the rights back to Marvel. Since then, the Fox characters have come in a few at a time: Kelsey Grammer's Beast in The Marvels and Channing Tatum's Gambit in Deadpool & Wolverine, where he finally played the role he was once cast in for a film that was never made.
avengers-vs-x-men-doomsday.src: X-Men (2000); The Marvels (2023), mid-credits scene; Deadpool & Wolverine (2024)

zendaya-mj.t: Mary Jane Watson's comic entrance is one of the most famous in Marvel: she meets Peter in 1966 with the line 'Face it, Tiger, you just hit the jackpot!' Zendaya's Michelle is a different kind of person, a sharp and dry member of the academic decathlon team who would rather read than flirt.
zendaya-mj.src: The Amazing Spider-Man #42 (1966), by Stan Lee and John Romita Sr.; Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017)

zendaya-mj.t: In Far From Home, Michelle works out on her own that Peter is Spider-Man, and they share their first kiss on Tower Bridge in London.
zendaya-mj.src: Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), Tower Bridge

venom-fights-spider-man-nwh.t: Venom first appeared in a 1988 issue of The Amazing Spider-Man, when the black suit Peter rejected bonds with the reporter Eddie Brock. A Spider-Man and Venom fight is the oldest matchup the character has, which is why the credits scene felt like a promise.
venom-fights-spider-man-nwh.src: The Amazing Spider-Man #300 (1988), by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane

ten-rings-from-space.t: The comic's Mandarin first appeared in 1964 as an Iron Man villain who found ten rings in a crashed alien starship. Fin Fang Foom, the giant dragon fans connect to the rings, is even older: he first appeared in a 1961 monster comic and was later revealed to be a Makluan.
ten-rings-from-space.src: Tales of Suspense #50 (1964), by Stan Lee and Don Heck; Strange Tales #89 (1961), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby

ten-rings-from-space.t: The film never tells us where Wenwu found the rings, only that he has worn them for about a thousand years and that they keep him from aging. It also shows that they react to power in Ta Lo and that they can be passed on: Shang-Chi takes them at the end.
ten-rings-from-space.src: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)

teen-is-nicholas-scratch.t: Agatha Harkness began in a 1970 Fantastic Four comic as the witch hired to babysit Franklin Richards, and her son Nicholas Scratch arrived a few years later as a villain leading the Salem Seven. The show kept Nicholas only as a lost child in Agatha's past, which is what made a hidden boy look like he could be him.
teen-is-nicholas-scratch.src: Fantastic Four #94 (1970), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Fantastic Four #185 (1977), by Len Wein and George Perez

teen-is-billy-maximoff.t: Episode 7 explains how Billy came back. When Wanda's Hex fell, Billy's soul went into William Kaplan, a teenager who had just been in a car crash outside Westview, and he grew up in that body without knowing it. In the comics he goes by Billy Kaplan too, and becomes the hero Wiccan of the Young Avengers.
teen-is-billy-maximoff.src: Agatha All Along, episodes 6 and 7 (Disney+, 2024); Young Avengers #1 (2005), by Allan Heinberg and Jim Cheung

sylvie-is-enchantress.t: The Enchantress, Amora, first appeared in a 1964 Thor comic, and the comics later gave the name to Sylvie Lushton, a young woman who believed she was Asgardian. The show only borrowed the first name: its Sylvie is a Loki variant whom the TVA took as a child and who has run from it ever since.
sylvie-is-enchantress.src: Journey into Mystery #103 (1964), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Loki, episodes 3 and 5 (Disney+, 2021)

sylvie-is-enchantress.t: Episode 5 shows how many Lokis there are. In the Void at the end of time, Loki meets Classic Loki, Kid Loki, Boastful Loki and an alligator, all hiding from the cloud monster Alioth.

strange-knew-tony-must-die.t: Strange chose his words with care on Titan. He had said he would let Tony and Peter die before handing over the Time Stone, then gives it to Thanos to stop him from killing Tony. Just before he turns to dust, he tells Tony it was the only way. Endgame's title comes from Strange's line that they are in the endgame now.
In Endgame's last battle, Strange holds the portals open and watches the gauntlet move across the field. When Tony looks at him, he lifts one finger, and Tony takes the stones and snaps.

steve-returns-as-nomad.t: Nomad first appeared in 1974, after Steve learned that a secret group led by a top government man was behind a plot, and he gave up being Captain America because he no longer trusted what the flag stood for. He fought as a man without a country for a short time before taking the shield back.
steve-returns-as-nomad.src: Captain America #180 (1974), by Steve Englehart and Sal Buscema

steve-returns-as-nomad.t: Sam's road to the shield took a whole series. In The Falcon and the Winter Soldier he gives it to a museum, the government hands it to John Walker, and Sam only takes the name in the finale. Brave New World was his first film as Captain America. Evans, meanwhile, came back once already as a different hero: his old Johnny Storm in Deadpool & Wolverine.
steve-returns-as-nomad.src: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (Disney+, 2021); Captain America: Brave New World (2025); Deadpool & Wolverine (2024)

sadie-sink-is-jean-grey.t: Jean Grey was one of the five first X-Men in 1963, as Marvel Girl. In 1976 she became the Phoenix, and the Dark Phoenix Saga of 1980 is one of the most famous X-Men stories. On film, Famke Janssen played her in the first Fox films and Sophie Turner in X-Men: Apocalypse and Dark Phoenix.
sadie-sink-is-jean-grey.src: The X-Men #1 (1963), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; X-Men #101 (1976) and #129 to #138 (1980), by Chris Claremont, Dave Cockrum and John Byrne

rocket-dies-in-vol-3.t: Rocket first appeared in a 1976 comic, named after the Beatles song Rocky Raccoon. Vol. 3 tells his origin: the High Evolutionary made him in a lab, where he grew up with three other test animals, Lylla, Teefs and Floor, who were killed. When the team cannot remove a kill switch inside him, Rocket stops breathing, and in a vision Lylla tells him it is not his time.
rocket-dies-in-vol-3.src: Marvel Preview #7 (1976), by Bill Mantlo and Keith Giffen; Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023)

rocket-dies-in-vol-3.t: The film ends with Rocket as the captain of a new team of Guardians, while Peter goes home to Earth to see his grandfather.
rocket-dies-in-vol-3.src: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023), ending and credits scene

rio-vidal-is-death.t: Death in the comics first appeared in 1973 in a Captain Marvel story by Jim Starlin, and she is the one Thanos tries to win when he gathers the Infinity Gems. Aubrey Plaza's Rio is Agatha's old flame as well as her hunter, which the show uses to explain why Death keeps not finishing the job.
rio-vidal-is-death.src: Captain Marvel #26 (1973), by Jim Starlin and Mike Friedrich; Agatha All Along (Disney+, 2024)

rhodey-skrull-since-civil-war.t: The airport fight in Civil War ends with Vision's beam hitting War Machine by mistake. Rhodey falls from the sky and breaks his back, and Tony builds him braces to walk. That injury is why fans saw the real Rhodey's weak legs in Secret Invasion's finale as a clue to when he was taken.
rhodey-skrull-since-civil-war.src: Captain America: Civil War (2016), the airport fight and the Avengers compound

real-mandarin.t: All Hail the King was a short film released with Thor: The Dark World on home video in 2014. A filmmaker interviews Trevor in prison, then reveals he works for the real Ten Rings and takes Trevor away to meet the Mandarin.
real-mandarin.src: All Hail the King (Marvel One-Shot, 2014), directed by Drew Pearce

quantum-realm-time-heist.t: The Realm was set up in Scott's first film. In Ant-Man he shrinks past the atom to stop Yellowjacket and only just finds his way back, which Hank says no one had done. Janet had been lost there for thirty years. In Endgame, Tony cracks the time travel with a model shaped like an upside-down Möbius strip, and the first tests turn Scott into a teenager, an old man and a baby.
quantum-realm-time-heist.src: Ant-Man (2015), the final fight; Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018); Avengers: Endgame (2019), the lab tests

quantum-realm-time-heist.t: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania later showed the Realm as a whole world with its own people, where Kang had been trapped.

pepper-and-rocket-rescue-tony.t: Pepper had worn armor before. In Iron Man 3, Tony's suit wraps around her to protect her, and in the final fight, powered by Extremis, she kills Aldrich Killian herself. In the comics her own suit, Rescue, first appeared in 2009, built by Tony to protect her and named for what it does.
pepper-and-rocket-rescue-tony.src: Iron Man 3 (2013), the final fight; The Invincible Iron Man #10 (2009), by Matt Fraction and Salvador Larroca

pepper-and-rocket-rescue-tony.t: Endgame's opening shows how close Tony came. He and Nebula drift on the Benatar with no fuel, play paper football to pass the time, and he records his goodbye in his helmet. Carol Danvers finds the ship and carries it home. Pepper's Rescue suit only appears in the final battle, where she fights beside Tony.
pepper-and-rocket-rescue-tony.src: Avengers: Endgame (2019), opening and final battle

odins-gauntlet-fake.t: The films later told where Thanos got his real gauntlet. In Infinity War, Thor reaches Nidavellir and finds the dwarf king Eitri alone. Eitri says Thanos forced him to build the gauntlet, then killed his people and ruined his hands. Age of Ultron's mid-credits scene shows Thanos putting it on and saying he will do it himself.
odins-gauntlet-fake.src: Avengers: Infinity War (2018), Nidavellir; Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), mid-credits scene

odins-gauntlet-fake.t: Odin's vault in the first Thor holds other famous items as well, such as the Casket of Ancient Winters that the Frost Giants want back. In Ragnarok, Hela walks past the same shelves, knocks the gauntlet over and calls it fake.
odins-gauntlet-fake.src: Thor (2011), Odin's vault; Thor: Ragnarok (2017), Odin's vault

no-way-home-three-spider-men.t: The three Peters bring their old films into one story. Andrew Garfield's Peter catches MJ as she falls, the save he could not make for Gwen Stacy. The villains cover twenty years of films: Alfred Molina's Doctor Octopus, Willem Dafoe's Green Goblin, Jamie Foxx's Electro, the Sandman and the Lizard.
no-way-home-three-spider-men.src: Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), the Statue of Liberty battle

mysterio-is-alive.t: Beck's job before villainy matters to this theory. He worked for Stark Industries on B.A.R.F., the hologram tech that can make anything look real, and his team runs drones that show the world whatever he wants. A faked death is the kind of trick his whole plan was built on, which is why fans do not trust the body on the bridge.
mysterio-is-alive.src: Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), the pub scene with Beck's team

mysterio-is-alive.t: No Way Home shows only his old footage. Jake Gyllenhaal does not appear, but his recorded claim that Spider-Man killed him drives the whole first act of that film.

moon-knight-jake-lockley.t: In the comics Jake Lockley is a taxi driver, one of the identities Marc uses to hear what is happening on the streets of New York. Moon Knight's 1980 comic set up the three names, Marc Spector, Steven Grant and Jake Lockley, as part of how he fights crime.
moon-knight-jake-lockley.src: Moon Knight #1 (1980), by Doug Moench and Bill Sienkiewicz

maria-hill-is-a-skrull.t: Cobie Smulders had played Hill since The Avengers in 2012, and she appeared in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. too. The last time fans saw her before Secret Invasion, in Far From Home, it was not even her: the end of that film reveals the Skrull Soren had been posing as Hill. That history is why some fans did not believe the death at first.
maria-hill-is-a-skrull.src: The Avengers (2012); Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), post-credits scene

maria-hill-is-a-skrull.t: In episode 2, Fury takes her body to her mother and stays for the funeral.

kamala-khan-mutant.t: The comics later moved in the same direction. In 2023, after Kamala died and was brought back on the mutant island of Krakoa, Marvel revealed she had been a mutant as well as an Inhuman. Her original 2014 comic gave her powers from the Terrigen Mist that wakes Inhumans.
kamala-khan-mutant.src: Ms. Marvel #1 (2014), by G. Willow Wilson and Adrian Alphona; Ms. Marvel: The New Mutant #1 (2023), by Iman Vellani, Sabir Pirzada and Carlos Gomez

kamala-forms-young-avengers.t: The comic team began in 2005 with teens linked to older heroes: Patriot, Hulkling, Wiccan and the time-lost Iron Lad. Cassie Lang joined as Stature, Kate Bishop as Hawkeye and Tommy Shepherd as Speed. Kamala herself joined Marvel's teen team the Champions in a later comic.
kamala-forms-young-avengers.src: Young Avengers #1 to #12 (2005 to 2006), by Allan Heinberg and Jim Cheung

kamala-forms-young-avengers.t: Several of those heroes are already on screen. Eli Bradley appears in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier as the grandson of Isaiah Bradley, Cassie Lang wears her own suit in Quantumania, and Billy Maximoff learns his powers in Agatha All Along.
kamala-forms-young-avengers.src: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (2021); Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania (2023); Agatha All Along (2024)

jude-law-is-mar-vell.t: Mar-Vell first appeared in 1967 as a Kree soldier sent to spy on Earth who turns against his people. Carol Danvers met him the next year, and in later comics she gets her powers in an explosion near him. The film kept that core and changed who stood where.
jude-law-is-mar-vell.src: Marvel Super-Heroes #12 (1967), by Stan Lee and Gene Colan

jude-law-is-mar-vell.t: In Captain Marvel, Mar-Vell hides on Earth as Dr. Wendy Lawson, a scientist building a light-speed engine with the Tesseract's power. When Yon-Rogg shoots down their test plane, Carol destroys the engine and takes in its energy. Yon-Rogg then raises her as Vers in his Starforce unit, and Annette Bening also plays the face she sees when the Supreme Intelligence speaks to her.

jane-foster-not-dead.t: Jane first appeared in 1962 as a nurse working with Thor's human form, Donald Blake. The film followed Jason Aaron's comics, where Jane lifts Mjolnir and becomes Thor while fighting breast cancer, and where every change into Thor undoes her chemotherapy. In the comics she later comes back and keeps fighting as a hero.
jane-foster-not-dead.src: Journey into Mystery #84 (1962), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; The Mighty Thor #1 (2015), by Jason Aaron and Russell Dauterman

hawkeye-hearing-loss.t: The comic run fans had in mind is Matt Fraction and David Aja's Hawkeye from 2012. In one issue, after Clint is badly hurt and loses his hearing, most of the story is told in sign language with no word balloons translated, so readers feel what he feels.
hawkeye-hearing-loss.src: Hawkeye vol. 4 #19 (2014), by Matt Fraction and David Aja

hawkeye-hearing-loss.t: The show ties his hearing loss to years of fighting with explosive arrows. His hearing aid breaks during a fight, and Kate has to speak right at him or write things down. It also brings in Maya Lopez, a Deaf hero played by Deaf actor Alaqua Cox.

doomsday-centers-on-earth-828.t: Earth-828 is a retro-future world styled after the 1960s, where the Fantastic Four are the only heroes and everyone knows them. In First Steps, Galactus comes to eat the planet, and the Silver Surfer, here Shalla-Bal played by Julia Garner, arrives first to warn them. The team, Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach, saves it, with baby Franklin at the center of both Galactus's demand and the team's plan.

Thunderbolts*'s credits scene jumps fourteen months ahead to the New Avengers in their tower, and a spaceship with the Fantastic Four's 4 on it comes into Earth's orbit. Fans read the gap as the time between the two films.

doom-wants-franklin.t: Franklin Richards was born in 1968 in the comics, and in time he turned out to have the power to make whole universes. In the 1996 Heroes Reborn story, the heroes live on a world Franklin made without knowing it. That power is why fans think Doom would want him.
doom-wants-franklin.src: Fantastic Four Annual #6 (1968), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Heroes Reborn (1996)

doom-wants-franklin.t: Doom also has a family history with the Richards children. In the comics he helps deliver Reed and Sue's daughter and names her Valeria, after a woman he loved. In the 2015 Secret Wars, when Doom rules Battleworld, Sue is his wife and Franklin and Valeria are raised as his children.
doom-wants-franklin.src: Fantastic Four vol. 3 #54 (2002); Secret Wars (2015), by Jonathan Hickman and Esad Ribic

doom-is-the-hero.t: Doom has always believed he knows better than everyone. In the comics he rules the small country of Latveria with an iron hand and keeps its people fed and safe. In the 1987 graphic novel Emperor Doom, he takes over the whole world with mind control, and war and hunger end, until he grows bored of a world that never fights him.
doom-is-the-hero.src: Fantastic Four #5 (1962), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; Emperor Doom (1987), by David Michelinie and Bob Hall

doom-is-the-hero.t: His origin is about blame. Books of Doom retells it: Victor's mother is lost to a demon's deal, and at university a machine he built to reach her blows up in his face. He blames Reed Richards, who had warned him of a mistake in his math, and spends his life trying to prove he is the better man.
doom-is-the-hero.src: Books of Doom #1 to #6 (2005 to 2006), by Ed Brubaker and Pablo Raimondi

doom-is-the-hero.t: The 2015 Secret Wars is the clearest case. When every universe dies, Doom saves what he can and builds Battleworld, and he rules it as a god. In the last issue he admits that Reed would have done a better job with the same power.
doom-is-the-hero.src: Secret Wars #9 (2016), by Jonathan Hickman and Esad Ribic

clea-incursion-leads-to-secret-wars.t: Clea first appeared in 1964 in Doctor Strange's early comics, as the niece of Dormammu, ruler of the Dark Dimension, and she later becomes Strange's partner. Charlize Theron plays her in the film's credits scene, where she opens a portal and takes Strange into that dimension.
clea-incursion-leads-to-secret-wars.src: Strange Tales #126 (1964), by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko; Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022), mid-credits scene

clea-incursion-leads-to-secret-wars.t: The film had already shown what an incursion costs. On Earth-838, the Illuminati explain that their own Strange used the Darkhold and caused an incursion that wiped out another universe, so they killed him for it. The warning hangs over the Strange of the main MCU, who used the same book.
clea-incursion-leads-to-secret-wars.src: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022), the Illuminati scene

bucky-becomes-captain-america.t: The comic run fans had in mind is Ed Brubaker's. He brought Bucky back as the Winter Soldier in 2005, then had Steve shot dead on the courthouse steps after the superhero Civil War in 2007. Bucky took up the shield and a new costume in 2008 and stayed Captain America until Steve returned.
bucky-becomes-captain-america.src: Captain America vol. 5 #1 (2005), #25 (2007) and #34 (2008), by Ed Brubaker and Steve Epting

bucky-becomes-captain-america.t: The MCU sent Bucky down another road. In The Falcon and the Winter Soldier he works through his list of people to make amends to, and in Thunderbolts* he has become a congressman before he joins the new team.
bucky-becomes-captain-america.src: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (Disney+, 2021); Thunderbolts* (2025)

bob-is-the-void.t: Before the Void comes out, the film treats Bob as a stranger who stumbles into the plot. Yelena, John Walker, Ghost and Taskmaster are all sent to the same vault by Valentina to kill each other, and Bob wakes up among them with no memory of how he got there. He is the survivor of Valentina's O.X.E. Group project to build a new hero.

When the Void takes over, people in New York turn into shadows burned into walls and are trapped inside rooms of their worst memories. The team only beats it by going into that darkness and staying with Bob in his own memories.

agnes-is-agatha.t: Agatha Harkness began in 1970 as a witch who helps the Fantastic Four, and in later comics she became Wanda's teacher in magic. Episode 7's reveal comes with a theme song, 'Agatha All Along', written by Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez, the songwriters behind Frozen, and it became the title of her own series.
agnes-is-agatha.src: Fantastic Four #94 (1970), by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby; WandaVision, episode 7 (Disney+, 2021)

aerospace-engineer-is-reed-richards.t: The timing explains why fans were so sure. Marvel announced its Fantastic Four film in December 2020, only weeks before WandaVision began. Monica Rambeau, who first appeared in a 1982 comic as Captain Marvel, had just come back from the Blip, and she was looking for any help she could get to break into the Hex.
aerospace-engineer-is-reed-richards.src: Disney Investor Day, December 10, 2020; The Amazing Spider-Man Annual #16 (1982), by Roger Stern and John Romita Jr.

aerospace-engineer-is-reed-richards.t: The engineer, Major Goodner, brings Monica a rover built to get through the Hex. Monica walks through the barrier herself instead, and the energy changes her cells and gives her powers. The man who directed WandaVision, Matt Shakman, later directed The Fantastic Four: First Steps, so the two did end up linked after all.
aerospace-engineer-is-reed-richards.src: WandaVision, episode 7 (Disney+, 2021); The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025)
